predictions: Ohmigosh, week 6 was a flaming hot bag of garbage in prediction land. Not only did we dump TWO matches to forfeits, but then I stunk it up on my picks, with a pretty pathetic 13-10 week (with 2 still unreported). I did miss a 12-12, two 13-11s, and some 14-10s, so they were close at least. Plus, I got the Corks and What the Point right in one fell swoop, which surely drove them nuts. Love that so. Now 110-48 (69.6%) so far.

Match of the week: (H Div.) SofaKings @ Double Vision. Here we goooo!!! Last battle of unbeatens this season in any division! H has looked like a two-team fight for quite some time, and now that pair steps into the ring. Any night can be the night, but man have these two gotten here via different paths. I think Sofa is too dominant, 15-9.

Match #2: (B Div.) The Kids who say "Ni!" @ Why So Serious? If it hadn't taken the Kids a week to get on track this season, this would be another battle of unbeatens. It's still a head-to-head for the lead in B though, so the drama here is off the charts. You know, I didn't think I would pick against Serious again this fall, but here I am… Kids, 13-11.

Match #3: (G Div.) Banging the Wire @ Rippin Darts. The stunning forfeit loss by Rippin last week all of a sudden turned a runaway race into a full-on battle for first! Since nobody has outdueled them on an actual dartboard yet, I still have to ride the Rippin train here, 15-9.

Match #4: (C Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Area 501. What the heck was that week 5 hibernation act Menace pulled? That's the only thing preventing this from being yet another battle of unbeatens. Alas, this is just another rung on Area's climb to B (and A?). Area it is, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Point & Rally. After an 0-2 start, Sanchez is now 4-2 and alone in 3rd. They'll still be 3rd after this one, but they will another match behind the leaders. Point Rallies here, 15-9.

Match #6: (A Div.) The Inflationary Element @ Appetite for Destruction. With Jonesing knocking off both of these teams in the last two weeks, this is suddenly the battle for 2nd. I'll stick with my Element, 14-10.
Match #7: (F Div.) Two Time @ Down to F, Again. Don't look now, but if Two Time gets help from Nein Mark, they could find them- selves leading F by the end of the night. They win, but only 13-11.

Match #8: (A Div.) Wing & A Plaque @ Son of a Beach. The battle for a spot in the league's top four is a carousel of results each week. Does that mean it's Beach's turn then? Of course it does, duh. 13-11.

Matches #9 & #10: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Nine Lives; The Bullies @ Shooter McGavin. The bottom five in D are so close together that's it's about one or two darts from 4th to friggin' last. Thus, battles within that quintet are just extra super-important. Still love the Niners more than I should, 15-9; and… McGavin? 13-11?

Match #11: (B Div.) Liquor Possee @ Consistently Inconsistent. The Possee is two matches out of first, but because of their strong point total, they mostly control their own fate. They get this, 14-10.

Match #12: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ That's What She Said. Ok, look… it's only 3 matches and 13 points from first to last in F. ALL F teams are still in this title chase. Yep, all. She Said to win, 14-10.
And the remaining 15 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Jonesing for Mugs 18, Dart Attack 6.
B Division: Angry Birds 14, Bottoms Up 10.
